dimensions.label: Problem Clarity
dimensions.evidence: John presents canvases mostly over screen-share in meetings (projector and unattended kiosk use also on the table) and today pans and zooms by hand between viewpoints.

dimensions.label: Goal Definition
dimensions.evidence: Five goals: four locked from the strawman plus a per-slide path goal added when the scope-creep critic flagged per-slide paths as MVP work with no goal.

dimensions.label: Success Criteria
dimensions.evidence: Five command checks (slide-model, viewport-fit, autoplay/key-map, no-write, full suite/build/lint) plus five judgment checks mapped one-to-one to the goals; John approved the original set and critics added two command checks.

dimensions.label: Scope Boundaries
dimensions.evidence: John accepted the strawman's MVP list and out-of-scope list (HTML export, transitions, speaker notes, thumbnails, multiple decks, true full-screen, drag reorder) as written.

dimensions.label: Consistency
dimensions.evidence: zoomToBbox's 100% zoom cap conflicts with replaying zoomed-in captures, resolved by a custom fit; exit behavior with path highlights resolved by John (clear all highlights).

problem: John walks people through Obsidian canvases (for example Shepherd Factory Lifecycle) by panning and zooming by hand. Mostly this happens over screen-share in meetings, sometimes on a projector, and possibly on an unattended display that should cycle on its own.

Hand navigation is slow, inconsistent between runs, and pulls attention away from the talk. There is no way to save a sequence of viewpoints, step through them with a keyboard or presentation clicker, or let the canvas cycle unattended.
goals: Present a deck of 5+ slides on Shepherd Factory Lifecycle start to finish using only keyboard or clicker, with zero mouse panning or zooming.
Auto-play a deck unattended: it loops with each slide's own duration (10s default) for 10+ minutes without manual input.
The same deck, after Obsidian Sync, plays on John's phone using only the on-screen tap bar.
A presentation session that does not edit slides leaves the .canvas file byte-identical.
A slide can carry one saved highlight path: presenting that slide shows the path highlighted, and moving to a slide without a path shows no highlight.

successCriteria.criterion: Slide model: add, update-to-view, rename, move up/down, delete, set/clear path, set/clear duration, default duration, read/patch canvas data with missing/valid/corrupt values
Viewport fit: a rect captured at any zoom (including above 100%) replays to the same framing on the same screen size, and is centered and fully visible on a different screen size

Auto-play and key map logic: each slide's duration is used, missing duration falls back to 10s, the last slide wraps to the first, manual prev/next pauses auto-play, and each presentation key maps to the right action
A presentation session never saves: start, next/prev, Home/End, auto-play ticks, path apply and exit against a stub canvas call requestSave/setData 0 times
Full suite, type-check/bundle, and lint pass

check.cmd: npx vitest run && npm run build && npm run lint

mvp.item: Slides button in the canvas control bar with a menu: Add slide from current view, slide list, Start presentation, Start auto-play
mvp.reason: Entry point, matching the Paths button pattern from PR #1

mvp.item: Per-slide actions: Go to, Update to current view, Set/clear highlight path, Set duration, Rename, Move up, Move down, Delete
mvp.reason: Everything needed to build and maintain a deck by tap. Desktop authoring is verified; mobile authoring uses the same menu but no criterion checks it (Goal 3 covers mobile playback only)

mvp.item: Slide = captured canvas rect (from the current viewport) plus optional path id and optional duration
mvp.reason: John chose captured view rects; paths reuse PR #1's highlighter

mvp.item: Presentation mode: hides canvas UI, shows a tap bar (prev, n/total, next, play/pause, exit)
mvp.reason: Works the same on screen-share, projector and phone

mvp.item: Keys while presenting: Right/Space/PageDown next, Left/PageUp previous, Home/End, P play/pause, Esc exit; plus Next/Previous slide commands bindable in Hotkeys
mvp.reason: PageUp/PageDown make presentation clickers work out of the box

mvp.item: Go-to-slide fits the slide rect to the screen without the 100% zoom cap and applies its path highlight (or none)
mvp.reason: Exact framing at any capture zoom; consistent highlight per slide

mvp.item: Auto-play: per-slide durations with a 10s default, loops at the end, any manual navigation pauses it
mvp.reason: Kiosk/unattended use is on the table

mvp.item: Slides stored in the .canvas file under canvasToolsSlides, written through the canvas save as undo steps
mvp.reason: Same sync-safe storage as paths (Obsidian Sync does not sync plugin subfolders)

mvp.item: Exit clears all path highlights; starting a presentation ends path edit mode

outOfScope.item: Transitions beyond Obsidian's own pan/zoom animation

decisions.decision: A slide is a captured canvas rect from the current view
decisions.rejected: A slide points at a group or node and zooms to fit it
decisions.reason: Matches 'view points' literally and needs no groups per framing

decisions.decision: A slide can optionally show one highlight path
decisions.reason: Lets John walk routes like 'Workable - Merged' as slides, reusing PR #1
John wants unattended use available from the first version

decisions.decision: Built-in presentation keys plus bindable Next/Previous commands
decisions.rejected: Commands only, or built-in keys only
decisions.reason: Clickers work out of the box and keys stay customizable

decisions.decision: Presentation mode hides canvas UI only
decisions.reason: Fewer edge cases (Esc, popouts, mobile); Obsidian's full-screen covers projector use
John wants per-slide control for kiosk loops

decisions.decision: On-screen tap bar for touch navigation
decisions.reason: No conflict with canvas pan and pinch

decisions.decision: Reorder with Move up/down in the menu
decisions.reason: Plain tap actions, far less UI

decisions.rejected: Restore the path showing before the presentation

decisions.decision: Custom viewport fit (set tx/ty/tZoom) instead of zoomToBbox
decisions.reason: zoomToBbox caps zoom at 100% and adds 10% padding, so zoomed-in captures would not replay as framed

decisions.decision: Phase 1 starts with a viewport spike and is rated medium risk
decisions.rejected: Treat viewport internals as known, low risk
decisions.reason: Hidden-dependency critic: the spike doc has no viewport section

decisions.decision: Slides and paths share one per-view Highlighter via a path-controller API
decisions.reason: Hidden-dependency critic: two highlighters would overwrite each other's ct-path-* classes and the 300ms data poll

decisions.decision: Presentation captures keys before the canvas and blocks node select/drag/nudge
decisions.rejected: Plain key listeners alongside canvas handling
decisions.reason: Hidden-dependency critic: Space pans and arrows nudge nodes, and a nudge or selection saves the file, breaking Goal 4

decisions.decision: Auto-play and key map are pure modules with fake-timer tests; a no-write test guards Goal 4
decisions.rejected: Only judgment checks for auto-play and no-write
decisions.reason: Success-criteria critic: both are mechanical properties a command can check

decisions.decision: Per-slide paths stay in MVP with their own goal (Goal 5)
decisions.rejected: Move per-slide paths to a later tier
decisions.reason: Scope-creep critic flagged MVP work with no goal; John chose the feature, so a goal was added instead

phases.title: Slide model, viewport fit, internals
phases.notes: Starts with a viewport spike recorded in docs/superpowers/spikes/2026-10-24-canvas-internals.md: fields to read/write (tx/ty/tZoom, getViewportBBox, canvasRect), redraw call (markViewportChanged), and confirmation that viewport changes never call requestSave. Then pure slide-model and viewport-fit modules with tests; LiveCanvas gains viewport read/write and screen size

phases.title: Slides menu
phases.notes: Slides toolbar button and per-slide actions, written through the canvas save. Refactors CanvasPathController to expose a small API (show path by id, clear highlight, stop edit mode) so the slides controller drives the single per-view Highlighter instead of a second one fighting over ct-path-* classes; registerLiveCanvas creates both controllers per view

phases.title: Presentation mode and auto-play
phases.notes: Starts with a spike: which canvas UI elements to hide on desktop and mobile, and how canvas binds Space (hold-to-pan) and arrow keys (node nudge). Presentation captures its keys in the capture phase on the canvas wrapper (or an Obsidian Scope) and stops propagation, and blocks node select/drag/nudge while presenting so nothing can trigger a save. Tap bar, path per slide via the path-controller API, pure autoplay and key-map modules with fake-timer tests, and a no-write test against a stub canvas

phases.title: Hands-on verification
phases.notes: First deploy the build to the phone (community-plugin sync or manual install) and reload the plugin there. Then John runs the five judgment checks on desktop and phone
